specFidelityNotes: Diff b50c82c..a53b8719 (#530 P2.10-A6). Pure analytics_kpi_masking package implements ADR-038 identity mask / real magnitudes: mask_public_analytics_envelope deep-copies envelope, aliases shop_display_name (Demo Shop N), product/order/SKU ids (demo-{kind}-{hmac}), and product titles (Demo Product N) via stable HMAC; strips merchant_id/tiktok_merchant_id and buyer PII keys; replaces top-level shop_id with demo alias; preserves KPI series numeric magnitudes and availability flags unchanged. No numeric noise or scale-factor masking. Scope-limited transform ready for #531 read path — does not touch Redis (#529) or apps/demo. Six pytest cases cover all four ACs plus input immutability and buyer PII stripping.

convention_notes.note: Documents identity block contract, forbidden PII keys, and explicit rule to never apply numeric noise to KPI series — aligned with ADR-038 §8.
Stdlib-only HMAC helpers; no I/O; deep-copy input before transform — matches backend service conventions.
